messages.subject: Lunch bag defect
messages.text:
Hi there,

I wanted to reach out because I purchased one of your lunch bags about a month and a half ago, and after a handful of uses I noticed the seams on both ends of the webbing beginning to rip. I bought it from the Local Refillery in Courtenay, BC and didn’t get a receipt at the time but I believe I’m past the return date now. 

I adore this lunch bag and I’m worried the seams are ripping further with each use. I will attach some images of the bag to show the issue. I would greatly appreciate any solutions you have to offer as I do want to continue using this bag! 

Thank you!

Kind regards,

Layla Burgess
